items.caption: Modern redraw of 言 in Shuowen seal-script style, the traditional semantic element cited in 語’s received analysis.
items.alt: A modern vector rendering of 言 in a seal-script form.
items.selection_reason: Shows the semantic component named by the dictionary analysis. It is an explicitly modern redraw, not an ancient artifact image.

items.caption: Modern redraw of 吾 in Shuowen seal-script style, the phonetic element named in the received account of 語.

limitations.text: No verified direct glyph image of an early 語 inscription was established in this run; the search-result paleographic report could not be reopened, and the Xiaoxuetang character query returned no readable form record.
